description: This file defines an enumeration class 'LogCategory' that specifies various categories for connection logs, such as source, target, response, and connection.

classes.name: LogCategory
classes.description: An enum representing different log categories for connection logs, with methods to retrieve the category name and find a category by name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the label used in JSON representation for the log category.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: Static method to retrieve an Optional containing the LogCategory matching the given name.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the log category as a string.
